title: [Bug]: completed_response None dereference crashes agent session
body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I have searched the existing [issues](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/issues) and [discussions](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/discussions), and this is not a duplicate.
- [x] This is a bug, not a usage question. (For questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/discussions/new?category=general) instead.)

### Background / Description

In Agent._reasoning_impl(), when processing a streaming model response, completed_response remains None if the async generator yields zero chunks, or if the stream is cut off before any chunk with is_last=True arrives.
The code then dereferences .usage and .content on None, causing AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'usage'. This unhandled exception propagates through _reasoning_impl → _reasoning → _reply_impl and crashes the entire agent session.

### Error Messages

```shell
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'usage'
Location: src/agentscope/agent/_agent.py, Agent._reasoning_impl(), around line 856.
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Trigger conditions:
Streaming model that uses the is_last flag.
Empty async generator, network interruption, or premature stream close.

### Environment

- AgentScope Version: 2.0.1
- Python Version:3.12
- OS:Linux

linked_prs.title: fix(agent): guard against empty or interrupted streaming responses
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/agent/_agent.py b/src/agentscope/agent/_agent.py
index 8258fce800..2a429985dd 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/agent/_agent.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/agent/_agent.py
@@ -843,6 +843,15 @@ async def _reasoning_impl(
                 block_id=data_block_id,
             )
 
+        # Guard against empty or interrupted streaming responses.
+        if completed_response is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Model returned an empty streaming response: no is_last=True"
+                " chunk was received.  The model call may have been "
+                "interrupted mid-stream (network dropout, timeout, or model "
+                "bug).",
+            )
+
         # Send the model call ended event with usage if available
         yield ModelCallEndEvent(
             reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
